summary: Full backend + frontend test pass for The White Mug – Cafe MVP. 7/7 pytest backend tests green (health, manifest, image serving, path traversal 400, 404, all 16 slugs served >10KB, hero >100KB). Frontend Playwright covered hero, sticky nav, menu filters/search, signature grid, reviews, location, reservation WhatsApp deep-link, validation, and ESC-to-close. No console errors, no broken images.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py path traversal check rejects '..' but relies on filename not containing '/', '\\', or '..'. Consider resolving path and asserting is_relative_to(STATIC_IMAGES_DIR) for defence in depth.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan context.
Menu heading claims '~80 handcrafted items' while data has 74; either update copy to '~75' or expand data to match brief ('~75 items' in requirements).

ReservationDialog validation via HTML5 'required' bypasses inline error path unless JS submit event bypasses. Consider removing 'required' attr so custom inline error shows during normal click submit as brief expects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Reservation is fully client-side — spy on window.open before clicking submit ('window.open = (u)=>{window.__wapp=u}'). Note: reserve inputs use HTML5 required, so empty-submit test must dispatch form submit via JS to see the inline error. Headline text 'Specially Coffee House' is split into per-word spans by kinetic reveal so page.get_by_text won't match; assert visibility via hero container instead.
